summary: Upgraded the ClientApp from Angular 15.2 to Angular 16.2 using `ng update @angular/core@16 @angular/cli@16`, and bumped @ngrx/* from 15 to 16 to match. Angular's CLI migration disabled `buildOptimizer` for the non-optimized server configuration in angular.json. The only hand fix needed was src/main.server.ts, which still re-exported `renderModuleFactory` (removed in v16); the Angular 16 server builder now injects the platform-server exports itself, so the file was changed to export `AppServerModule`. `npm install`, `npm run build` and `npm run build:ssr` pass; `npm run test` still fails for the same pre-existing reason as at baseline (unchanged error).
changes: angular.json: server builder's development configuration now sets "buildOptimizer": false (CLI migration).

src/main.server.ts: replaced `export { renderModuleFactory } from '@angular/platform-server'` (removed API in v16, broke `npm run build:ssr`) with `export { AppServerModule } from './app/app.server.module'`; the v16 server builder appends renderModule/renderApplication/SERVER_CONTEXT exports automatically.
manual_followups: Tests still fail exactly as at baseline: the `test` target in angular.json lists the stylesheet as "styles.css" instead of "src/styles.css", so Karma aborts with "Can't resolve 'styles.css'". Fixing that path is outside this hop but would let the suite run.
rxjs is still ^6.6.7; Angular 16 supports it, but rxjs 7 will be required soon and should be scheduled for an upcoming hop.
Deprecated/legacy devDeps remain (tslint, codelyzer, protractor, node-sass, core-js 2, @types/node 12, aspnet-prerendering); they are unused by the required checks but should be retired.
